component.name: Rust Hosts
component.summary: Edit the managed /etc/hosts block from a desktop app

description.p: Rust Hosts manages a marked block of the system hosts file. Group entries by environment and enable or disable them in one click, without editing the file by hand.

Every edit is shown in a diff before a root-owned helper writes the file. An automatic backup and a hash check protect against accidental changes and external edits. Content outside the managed block is preserved.
